title: 1.0.0_GetWorkflowResponse
description: The complete workflow transition graph for all forms within a work request.

workRequestId.description: The unique display identifier of the work request.

workRequestName.description: The human-readable name of the work request.

siteId.description: The billing identifier of the site associated with the work request.

siteName.description: The human-readable name of the site associated with the work request.

supplierId.description: The billing identifier of the supplier associated with the work request.

supplierName.description: The human-readable name of the supplier associated with the work request.

childForms.description: List of forms belonging to the work request, each with its workflow transition graph.

1.0.0_FormWorkflow.description: Workflow transition graph for a single form. Describes the form's current status and every valid state transition available in its workflow, grouped by source state and ordered by first appearance in the workflow definition.

formId.description: Unique display identifier for the form.

currentStatus.description: The human-readable name of the workflow status the form is currently in.

transitions.description: Ordered list of workflow transition groups. Each entry represents a source state and the set of states it can transition to. An empty array means the form is in a terminal state with no further transitions available.

1.0.0_TransitionTarget.description: A target state that a form can transition to from its current source state.

statusId.description: Unique identifier of the target workflow status.

name.description: Human-readable name of the target workflow status.

isFinal.description: Whether the target state is a terminal (final) state.

clientCanTransition.description: Whether the client (the authenticated API consumer) is permitted to trigger this transition. When `false`, the transition can only be initiated by Avetta or the supplier.

1.0.0_WorkflowState.description: Represents a single state in the workflow.

statusId.description: Unique identifier of the workflow status.

name.description: Human-readable name of the workflow status.

isFinal.description: Whether this is a terminal (final) state. A terminal state has no outgoing transitions — the form cannot move to any further state once it reaches one.

1.0.0_WorkflowTransition.description: A single transition group: one source state (`from`) and all the states it can move to (`to`). When a source state has multiple destinations (a diverging path), all destinations are listed together in this single entry. Non-terminal destinations are always listed before terminal ones within `to`.

to.description: Ordered list of target states reachable from the `from` state. Non-terminal states appear before terminal (final) states.
